name: tinycbor-redis
description: An expansion of node-tinycbor which provides access to select Redis commands with internal CBOR encoding/decoding

scripts.test: yarn run format:js && yarn run lint:test && mocha
scripts.install: git submodule init && git submodule update && yarn run cpp_redis:build && node-gyp rebuild
scripts.build: git submodule update && yarn run format:js && node-gyp configure build
scripts.cpp_redis:build: cd ./src/cpp_redis && git submodule init && git submodule update && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make && make install

author: Samuel Patterson
